verdict.rationale: Gmail ships Gemini as a built-in assistant that summarizes threads, acts on multiple emails and proposes meeting times using Google Calendar availability, so the assistant does reach the inbox and calendar. No evidence shows open-ended question answering across the whole inbox, such as 'who said what' or 'what's outstanding', with grounded or cited answers. A hands-on report of a summary hallucinating a delivery date also undercuts grounding. Missing for 10: documented inbox-wide natural-language Q&A, calendar-wide Q&A, source-grounded or cited answers, independent corroboration of answer accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
